A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SSPO research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–G. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable matching of the equations, figures, tables and appendix material.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic and real-data experiments, ablations, runtime measurements and qualitative comparisons in Section 5 and Appendices C, E–G.

after.justification: v3 retains these original SSPO experiments, runtime measurements, ablations and qualitative comparisons, including their reported outcomes.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same SimPO-based rewards, KDE threshold estimation, EMA stabilization, pseudo-labeling procedure and adaptive weighting of paired and unpaired losses.

E1.justification: Both use the same synthetic word-length task, UltraFeedback/UltraChat, UltraMedical-Preference/UltraMedical and DSP Business/17k Business Book data. AlpacaEval2.0 and MT-Bench coverage and the appendix evaluation scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding experiments. Table 2 retains DPO, ORPO, SimPO, SSRM, KTO and SPA; Appendix F retains DPO+SFT and SimPO+SFT in Table 10 and the SPA comparison in Table 12.

E3.justification: Data fractions, sample counts, noise settings, backbone sizes, training budgets and validation-based model selection remain identical in Section 5 and Appendices C and F. Evaluation metrics and judge-model protocols are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same label-noise tests, prior sensitivity and scheduler ablations, reward-distribution analysis, abundant-paired-data experiments and qualitative case studies. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report experimental point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed lists, empirical confidence intervals or significance tests. Neither the uncertainty reporting practice nor any statistical estimation procedure changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends, runtime measurements and qualitative outputs match throughout. For example, Table 2 retains Mistral SSPO length-controlled win rates of 26.7% and 30.0% at 1% and 10% UltraFeedback, while Table 12 retains 32.4% at 100%.

T1.justification: The Bayes-risk definitions, Theorem 1 and its sub-Gaussian assumptions, Appendix B proof and gradient analysis, and Appendix E complexity derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about theoretically justified threshold-based pseudo-labeling, learning from unpaired data and data efficiency. The claim comparing SSPO trained on 1% UltraFeedback with baselines trained on 10% is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning adaptive scheduling, confirmation bias, nonstationary rewards, prior sensitivity and latent preference transfer remain unchanged. No substantive limitation, applicability boundary or failure condition is added or revised.

D1.justification: The first-page code link changes from an anonymous 4open.science location to the named GitHub repository MLAI-Yonsei/SSPO. This changes the documented access route; implementation, hyperparameter, hardware and runtime details remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish changes to repository contents.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix D's positioning against SSRM and SPA, and the cited-work set are unchanged. References move across pages 11–14 because of the inserted acknowledgement, without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v3 replaces the Preprint header with Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026, identifies the corresponding author and adds a funding acknowledgement before the references. Scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–19 retain their displays, captions, structures and placement. Visual changes are limited to headers, first-page spacing and footnotes, and reference reflow caused by the new acknowledgement.

improvement.justification: The scientific arguments, experimental evidence and substantive exposition are unchanged, including all appendices. The publication header, corresponding-author note, funding acknowledgement and replacement code link provide limited administrative and access updates without materially changing the paper's evidential strength or clarity.
